drivingQuestion: From where is it derived that an animal involved in a transgression is disqualified from the altar?
outcomeNote: The question is answered in the next unit.

segments.he: וְשֶׁנֶּעֶבְדָה בּוֹ עֲבֵירָה וְכוּ׳. מְנָא הָנֵי מִילֵּי?
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «And» an animal «with which a transgression was performed,» and one that killed a person that was known on the basis of the testimony of one witness or the owner, are disqualified from being sacrificed. The Gemara asks: «From where are these matters» derived?
